cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Prove Your Loyalty
cards.instruction: Invent small tests of loyalty and judge every response without admitting there is a test.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Choose the reunion photo. Mine includes the whole group; Sam's cuts two people off.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Focus is one criterion, not the entire selection process. Would you at least put mine first in the committee email?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll send them side by side, the same size.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Order still guides attention. Put mine on the left, please; I spent Sunday fixing your slideshow.
